title: MorseCode
features:
✨ Features

🔤 Text → Morse Conversion
Automatically converts any text into Morse code actions.

🟢 Dot = Jump
Dots trigger a reliable humanoid jump using ChangeState(Jumping).

↔️ Dash = Side Step
Dashes move your character left or right and return to the original position (no drifting or circles).

🌍 World-Relative Movement
Uses world-based movement instead of camera-relative to avoid rotation bugs.

🧠 Auto Rotate Disabled During Dashes
Prevents unwanted turning or curved movement.

⏱️ Fully Custom Timings

Step distance (studs)

Step speed (walkspeed)

Element gap (dot/dash spacing)

Letter gap

Word gap

🔁 Auto Send Mode
Automatically sends Morse when you press Enter.

🧭 Left / Right Step Direction Toggle

🛑 Stop Button
Instantly cancels the current Morse sequence.

🐞 Optional Debug Mode
Prints humanoid and movement state info to the F9 console.

🖥️ Rayfield UI

Clean, modern interface

Config saving enabled

Easy sliders & toggles

🔒 Client-Only
No server scripts, no remotes fired for movement.
